limitations: Package/version vulnerability matching is not exploitation or complete reachability proof
No host kernel, Docker engine, development stage image, or private runtime volume scan
No claim that all CPython native/stdlib vulnerabilities are covered by python-pkg matching
Raw severities/statuses remain unfiltered; manual triage is recorded separately in Markdown
Alpine matching does not support unfixed vulnerabilities; Debian and Alpine counts have different vendor coverage
libuuid and ncurses origins remain; prior eight CVEs are assessed by exact vulnerable component scope, not source package disappearance
BusyBox mount/nsenter/gzip remain; absence of the reviewed util-linux implementation does not prove BusyBox has no other vulnerabilities

Native libraries statically bundled inside Python wheels are not independently matched by APK/Python package-version scanning; cryptography bundled OpenSSL and pillow.libs need separate upstream tracking.
